source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 3 June 1949, p. 5 ("County and rural council elections: results"); Dromore Leader, 11 June 1949, p. 4 ("Hillsborough Rural District: notice of result of elections (Form No. 23), dated 3 June 1949")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: votes as printed in the BNL results and in the returning officer's notice of result (page image read: Maze 247/200, Drumbo 215/189)

note: Triennial election of the sixteen district electoral divisions of Hillsborough rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. Two divisions, Maze and Drumbo, were contested; thirteen members were returned unopposed and, with no nomination for Carryduff, its retiring member was deemed re-elected (returning officer's notice of result, Dromore Leader, 11 June 1949, p. 4; round 2, 7 Nov 2026). Majority 26.
